title: The Thief's Stone
journal: The Eye of Argonia is the old priest-kings' jewel. It sits at the Root, under the sea below Teku-Sul Spire, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there, it can heal every sick tree. The last king shut it behind the Kings' Gate, which opens only with three seal-stones. Never-Writes-Twice sent me after the three seal-stones. A dead thief's stone lies in the warden's vault at Blackrose Prison, whose people, the Blackguards' heirs, attack strangers on sight. Their gate-captain stands outside the gate. I'm to get in: as a guest past the gate-captain (a toll, words or a duel), unseen past the walls, or by force.
objectives: Get into Blackrose Prison; the gate-captain stands at the gate. (marker: Corvus Ulvius, Blackrose Prison)

plan.going: The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits at the Root under Teku-Sul, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there it heals every sick tree. The Kings' Gate shuts it in and opens only with three seal-stones. I am a Reel-Ka of the Toh-Reel-Ka, hunting the three seal-stones that open the kings' gate at Teku-Sul before the Unbound get them. One lies in the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. The prison's people attack strangers.
plan.next: get into the prison; the gate-captain outside the gate is the first person to deal with
plan.ways: pay the gate-captain 300 gold, persuade him (Speech 75) or duel him until he yields: each makes me a guest, and the garrison stops attacking me; or slip past the walls unseen (Sneak, Invisibility), and they attack if they see me; or fight my way in (any fighting skill), and the whole garrison fights me

answers: I work for Never-Writes-Twice, who sent me to collect three seal-stones that open the Kings Gate to the Root, where the Eye of Argonia can heal sick Hist trees. The first stone is a dead thief stone in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison, held by the Blackguards heirs, who kill strangers.
Get into Blackrose Prison past the gate-captain Corvus Ulvius, then reach the warden vault in Raj-Kaal Hall, where raj-kaal Okaz-Teel keeps the key on his belt.
Pay 300 gold toll, persuade him with words, duel him, sneak over the walls, or use force. Also an Imperial in the hall has a buyer for the vault contents, so he is a rival.
I do not understand exactly what the Root and Eye are, or who the Collector is. I could learn by talking to people and reading.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Corvus Ulvius let me through the gate as a guest, and the Blackguards' heirs will not attack me now. The vault's key is on Okaz-Teel, the Naga raj-kaal in his hall. I'm to get the stone: buy the key from him for 1,000 gold, lift it from his belt, or pick the vault's lock at night when the hall is quiet. A theft that is seen turns the garrison on me. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, waits in the hall as the chief's guest; his ring of Kothringi silver helps a hand at locks and pockets, but a dead man gives no errands.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the Warden's Vault in Okaz-Teel's hall. (marker: Door to Warden's Vault, Okaz-Teel)

plan.going: I am inside as a guest; the garrison does not attack me
plan.next: get the stone from the warden's vault in Okaz-Teel's hall

Go into Raj-Kaal Hall and get the stone from the Warden Vault.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: I took the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. Two stones are still out, in the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked. I'm to take them.

plan.going: I took the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. Two stones are still out, in the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked. I'm to take them.

answers: I now hold the first Seal-Stone of the Kings, bought via the vault key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold. I work for Never-Writes-Twice; three stones open the Kings Gate to the Root.
Take the other two stones: Gemin (flooded vaults) and Vorannuhl (deepest hall); both are marked.
Go to either one first; Gemin is likely easier than Vorannuhl, and I may need waterbreathing for Gemin.
Still unknown: what the Root and Eye truly are, who the Collector is beyond Ennodius Vanin wanting vault goods, and what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar.
